# Runtime dependencies actually imported by the backend (server.py, models.py,
# layout.py, assembly.py). The original generated file also listed boto3,
# emergentintegrations, pandas, numpy, jq, typer, etc.; none of those are
# imported here, and `emergentintegrations==0.2.2` is not published on PyPI,
# which made `pip install -r requirements.txt` fail on a normal machine.
fastapi==0.110.1
uvicorn[standard]==0.25.0
# motor and pymongo move together. motor 3.3 reads pymongo internals that 4.9
# removed (`pymongo.cursor._QUERY_OPTIONS`), so an old motor cannot be paired with
# a new pymongo at all. The pair below is the one that both imports and passes the
# suite — and it is what makes Python 3.13+ work: pymongo 4.6.3 has no cp314
# wheels, so pip fell back to compiling it, which is where an install on a modern
# Python used to die.
motor==3.7.1
pymongo==4.18.3
python-dotenv>=1.0.1
pydantic>=2.6.4
email-validator>=2.2.0
